name: phonezero
description: Give your Grok Bot a phone for restaurant-reservation calling — zero infrastructure.

TELNYX_API_KEY.title: Telnyx API key
TELNYX_API_KEY.description: Secret. Bearer token for the Telnyx hosted MCP. Cursor's backend attaches it as the Authorization header; the Bot computer never stores it.

TELNYX_ACCOUNT_SID.title: Telnyx account SID
TELNYX_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Filled in after provisioning (ask the Bot to set up phone calling, or run scripts/provision.sh). Telnyx account SID used by TeXML REST paths (Accounts/:account_sid).

PHONEZERO_FROM_NUMBER.title: From number
PHONEZERO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Your Telnyx US DID in E.164, used as the caller ID on outbound calls. Fixture example: +15555550100.

PHONEZERO_TEXML_APP_ID.title: TeXML application ID
PHONEZERO_TEXML_APP_ID.description: Filled in after provisioning (ask the Bot to set up phone calling, or run scripts/provision.sh). Telnyx TeXML application SID the Bot passes when placing a call.

PHONEZERO_XAI_SIP_NUMBER.title: xAI Direct SIP number
PHONEZERO_XAI_SIP_NUMBER.description: E.164 number registered with xAI as byo_trunk — usually the same number as PHONEZERO_FROM_NUMBER (no second number required). Call-create To target: sip:{this}@sip.voice.x.ai;transport=tls (the agent answers first). Fixture example: +15555550101.

PHONEZERO_AGENT_NAME.title: Voice agent name
PHONEZERO_AGENT_NAME.description: Spoken name. Substituted once into the Builder prompt at agent creation ({agent_name}) and spoken in each call's task brief.

PHONEZERO_DISCLOSE_AI.title: Disclose automated assistant
PHONEZERO_DISCLOSE_AI.description: When true, the Builder prompt (substituted once at agent creation) includes the automated-assistant clause. Default on (EU AI Act disclosure norms). Also stated in each spoken brief. The agent always answers truthfully if asked whether it is an AI.
